reviewed.title: PG-SGA SF in nutrition assessment and survival prediction for elderly patients with cancer.

reviewed.rationale: Topically relevant but purpose-locked; no reuse despite apparent relevance.

British Dietetic Association Guidelines for the Dietary Management of Chronic Constipation in Adults.

conclusion: No historical repository paper was promoted into the first qualified thin slice. Two reusable candidates failed semantic-scope qualification; three apparently relevant sources were purpose-prohibited. This is a substantive A2R finding, not a migration failure.
